# تَسْتَطْرِدِي (tastaṭridī) /tas.tatˤ.ri.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَطْرَدَ (istaṭrada)
# تُسْتَطْرَدِي (tustaṭradī) /tus.tatˤ.ra.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَطْرَدَ (istaṭrada)
